content.text: {"core": "Recognition surfaces what is already present and names it — the act of calling something by its true name so the system can respond to it. Seated in its own position, what gets named is the naming itself: the habit of recognition either fires or it does not. Dormant, the signal sits unprocessed — real things accumulate without being registered, and nothing downstream knows they arrived.", "sheetLine": "The signal came in; nothing marked it as received."}
